note: Standalone recreations of the nine panels, ordered left to right and top to bottom. Requested dimensions in prompts may differ from native delivered dimensions; see dimensions.txt.

images.name: 01-emerald-arch
images.prompt:
Edit / isolate the specified single abstract image panel from the supplied Sanova brand presentation and recreate it as a standalone high resolution full-bleed image. The supplied board is a composition and color reference. Output ONLY ONE panel, with absolutely no header, logos, text, gutters, framing, rounded corners, grid, collage, or neighboring panels. Maintain the panel's characteristic composition and proportions. Premium extremely minimal abstract photographic blur gradient: huge organic defocused forms, extremely soft flowing tonal transitions, refined fine analog film grain evenly visible at close inspection. The fine grain is essential: delicate dense tiny stochastic speckles integrated into the tones, matte photographic texture, subtle but clearly perceptible, not smooth computer gradients. Grain should be fine, not coarse, not halftone dots, no scratch or dirt. Sanova palette: emerald #0B865A, soft green #3FB583, very deep forest #052F22 where dark, warm gray #BCBAB5 and ivory #F0EEEA where neutral. No orange, red, brown, blue, neon or artificial glossy effects. No recognizable objects. Render at the requested high pixel dimensions if supported; prioritize real fine-grained detail at large size, no pixelation or banding. 
TARGET: top row, LEFT wide panel of the reference. Requested output dimensions: 3840 × 1312 pixels, panoramic landscape approximately 2.93:1.
COMPOSITION: Emerald green fills the top and right edge. A huge soft light warm-gray arch rises from the lower left and center, with diffuse mint at the boundary; a darker emerald flowing band descends at the right.
